examples.title: Example-1
examples.yaml:
apic:
  tenants:
    - name: ABC
      policies:
        route_tag_policies:
          - name: Context1
            description: "My Tag"
            tag: 112233
examples.explanation: This data model creates the `Context1` tag and assigns it a value of `112233`. When applied to a specific VRF, it attaches a 32-bit tag to routes during redistribution into supported protocols. This tag serves as an identifier to prevent routing loops. Additionally, Route Tag Policies allow customization of the tag value on a per-VRF basis, which is essential in multi-VRF environments where transit routes are learned from multiple VRFs.
